cardOverview.overviewText: An iGlobe card designed for travel enthusiasts, offering rewards on international spends, milestone vouchers, and global acceptance.

benefitRows.name: Golf
benefitRows.offer: You get four complimentary rounds of green fee each year, which means you can play for free at selected courses.|You even receive one golf lesson every month, which is perfect for improving your skills on the cource.|If you still want to play more after using your complimentary rounds, you can enjoy a 50% discount on green fee beyond those initial rounds.|To book a game, you just need to call the MasterCard World Card Golf helpline.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Access the designated golf booking portal using the email ID registered with your credit card. Choose your preferred golf course, date, and time, and complete the booking. You’ll receive a confirmation via email, take this with you when you play. Note that additional costs like caddy fees and carts are usually not covered and must be paid at the course.

benefitRows.name: MakeMyTrip
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this voucher, log in at https://rblbank.com using your registered mobile number or net banking credentials. Then, navigate to the rewards section, select your MakeMyTrip voucher from the available benefits, and redeem it online at www.makemytrip.com.
